channel.title: Hürriyet Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Hürriyet Daily News (hurriyetdailynews.com)

item.title: Erdoğan says Türkiye to lead search for peace, stability
item.description: President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan has pledged to maintain Türkiye's regional influence and bolster its domestic defense industry during a New Year’s Eve address to soldiers.

item.title: 18th Istanbul Biennial to conclude after first phase
item.description: The 18th Istanbul Biennial, organized by the Istanbul Foundation for Culture and Arts (İKSV), will conclude after its first phase following curator Christine Tohmé’s decision to step down for personal reasons, bringing an end to the event’s planned three-year structure.

item.title: 'Döner,' 'lahmacun,' 'simit' lead food orders in Türkiye in 2025
item.description: Turkish leading online food delivery platform Yemeksepeti has revealed that "döner," thinly sliced meat roasted on a vertical rotisserie, "lahmacun," thin flatbread topped with spiced minced meat, and "simit," crisp sesame-encrusted bread ring, were Türkiye’s most popular food choices in 2025.

item.title: Severe snowstorm paralyzes life in Istanbul amid winter’s sudden grip
item.description: As the New Year’s echoes faded, a relentless snowstorm has tightened its grip on Istanbul, plunging the metropolis into chaos and leaving motorists stranded as heavy accumulation paralyzed the city’s major arteries.

item.title: Türkiye grants visa-free entry to Chinese nationals
item.description: A presidential decree published in Türkiye’s Official Gazette announced that Chinese nationals will be granted visa-free entry to Türkiye for tourism and transit purposes as of Jan. 2.

item.title: Türkiye ushers in 2026 with sparkling nationwide events
item.description: Türkiye ushered in 2026 with a stunning display of lights and sounds, as grand celebrations turned major cities into vibrant centers of shared joy, safely guarded by a strong security presence.

item.title: Deadly fire ravages New Year celebration in bar at luxury Swiss ski resort
item.description: A fire ripped through a crowded bar in the luxury Swiss ski resort town of Crans-Montana as revellers rang in the New Year, killing and injuring several people, police said early Thursday.

item.title: Greek Cyprus says 'won't block EU-Türkiye ties' during presidency
item.description: Greek Cyprus has said that it will not obstruct relations between the European Union and Türkiye, as it on Jan. 1 assumed the presidency of the Council of the European Union for the first half of the year.

item.title: Massive Istanbul march draws 520,000 in solidarity with Gaza
item.description: Around 520,000 people gathered early on Jan. 1 at Istanbul’s Galata Bridge for a large-scale march in support of Palestinians, highlighting the ongoing humanitarian crisis in the Gaza Strip after two years of Israeli attacks.

item.title: Türkiye to become hub of global diplomacy in 2026 with major summits
item.description: Türkiye is set to host a dense diplomatic calendar in 2026, headlined by the NATO leaders’ summit and the United Nations’ climate conference, with dozens of world leaders expected to visit the country.
